item.title: Designing Error Returns in Go: A Case Study in Domain-Orchestration Separation
item.description: Explore how to design error-returning functions in Go that separate domain logic from orchestration concerns. Learn why a custom RepairableResult type beats (bool, error) and error-only patterns when building observable, testable, and reusable validation logic in production systems.
